*I’d fix these before merging.* Reviewed `main...upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4`.

• *P2 — Extension parsing violates the documented contract* — `src/extension.js:2`
  `split('.')[1]` takes the text after the first dot, not the last, and doesn’t lowercase it. Consequently, `archive.tar.gz` and `photo.JPG` both resolve to `application/octet-stream` instead of `application/gzip` and `image/jpeg`. A dotless name also returns `undefined` rather than the documented empty string. Use the final dot-separated segment, lowercase it, and return `''` when there’s no extension.

• *P2 — Unknown extensions can return inherited objects/functions instead of a MIME string* — `src/content-type.js:11`
  `TYPES` is a normal object, so the lookup includes inherited properties. For example, `contentType('file.constructor')` returns the `Object` function, and `contentType('file.__proto__')` returns an object instead of the promised fallback. Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

All 3 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these cases. I reproduced both findings with read-only checks. No files changed.
